description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
